name: First Fruits Farm

description: In Summit, MS, First Fruits Farm raises Blueberries and Blackberries on a small farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
